title: A common module-to-abelian comparison intertwines structure-sheaf pullbacks
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field]. For every scheme $X$ over $k$ with structure morphism $f$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], there are additive equivalences $e_{X,f}:H_k^1(X,\mathcal O_X)\simeq H^1(X,\mathcal O_X)$, where the source is restricted-scalar module cohomology [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations] and the target is abelian structure-sheaf cohomology [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. These equivalences may be chosen simultaneously so that for every $k$-morphism $a:Y\to X$, with $f\circ a=g$, and every source class $x$, the equivalence $e_{Y,g}$ sends the scalar pullback of $x$, followed by the coefficient map $a^*\mathcal O_X\to\mathcal O_Y$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf], to the recorded abelian pullback of $e_{X,f}(x)$. No cup product or global structure-ring bijectivity hypothesis is used.

proof.text: Compute both cohomologies by the same sections complex of an injective unit-module resolution. Forgotten injectives are acyclic for abelian sections. Restriction of scalars preserves underlying additive groups. The constant-integer sheaf adjunction identifies terminal-open abelian cohomology with Sheaf.H. Use these common-resolution equivalences simultaneously for every scheme.

Lift the adjoint structure-sheaf map to the resolutions. The scalar inverse-image Ext construction, followed by the adjoint tensor-pullback unit map, represents this lift on sections; after forgetting scalars the abelian inverse-image Ext construction represents the same lift. The adjunction unit equation identifies the coefficient map with the structure-sheaf map. Independence of lifts up to homotopy yields the displayed naturality for the single family of common-resolution comparisons.

theorem scalar_unit_cohomology_pullback_comparison (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∃ e : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)),
      scalarCohomology f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 ≃+
        Sheaf.H (structureSheafAb X) 1,
      ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
        (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (a : Y ⟶ X) (h : a ≫ f = g)
        (x : scalarCohomology f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1),
        e Y g (scalarCohomologyMap g (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit a) 1
          (scalarCohomologyPullback f g a h (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 1 x)) =
            structureSheafCohomologyPullback a 1 (e X f x)
